thread:
Nora (partnerships): Quick thread to lock the SI handoff + arbitration flow for mixed marketplace + HW partner deals. Goal: unambiguous ownership, simple attribution, and a short escalation path. Thoughts?
Omar (sales): Sales needs a deterministic rule. Proposal: 24h auto-claim window for SI to run discovery; if unclaimed, AE gets the lead. But if SI uploads a signed LOA (letter of assistance) within 24h, they get an exclusive 5-day window.
Jae (solutions): LOA makes sense. Also want a pre-demo tag so we can block calendar slots and stop AE outreach during exclusivity. pre_demo=true will mute AE notifications unless escalation fires.
Felix (marketplace): For private offers we require two ids: marketplace_offer_id and hw_partner_credit_code. Marketplace exports must include hw_partner_credit_code to reconcile partner rebates.
Rhea (legal): Legal thumbs-up on LOA flow. We'll provide a short LOA template. For announcements, require partner signoff within 4 business days and a partner logo usage clause.
Nora (partnerships): Draft rules I'm hearing: 24h soft-claim; LOA -> exclusive 5d; pre_demo flag mutes AE; marketplace_offer_id + hw_partner_credit_code required for bundled offers; deals over $350k escalate to CRO + Partnerships. Any objections?
Omar (sales): One thing: attribution for marketplace-origin deals  we should credit the assigned AE unless AE unclaims. Add attribution_field in SFDC: origin_attribution and credited_ae.
Jae (solutions): Implementation note: intake webhook should accept: partner_tag, pre_demo, loa_url, marketplace_offer_id, hw_partner_credit_code, claimed_until. Example payload:
```json
{
  "lead": "L-2024-2301",
  "account": "Beta Tech",
  "partner_tag": "si-summit",
  "pre_demo": true,
  "loa_url": "https://s3.amazonaws.com/loas/loas/123.pdf",
  "marketplace_offer_id": "azure-private-8899",
  "hw_partner_credit_code": "NVIDIA-BUNDLE-2024",
  "claimed_until": "2024-06-15T12:00:00Z"
}
```
Felix (marketplace): We'll expose marketplace_offer_id and hw_partner_credit_code in the daily export. Also add a marketplace_origin boolean so SFDC can map quickly. ETA 3 business days.
Rhea (legal): LOA template + Announcement Addendum ready in draft. Recommend storing signed LOAs in the partnership drive and linking from intake (loa_url). We'll also add revocation terms for exclusivity.
intake-bot: Heads up: new intake fields will be accepted. See schema PR: https://github.com/redwood/integrations/pull/450
Nora (partnerships): Action items: Jae will PR the schema; Felix will update exports; Rhea will post LOA + announcement templates; Omar will propose SFDC field names and attribution logic. I'll assemble a one-page guide and schedule a 25-min walkthrough.
Omar (sales): Can we do the walkthrough tomorrow 10:30am PT? @Jae @Rhea
Jae (solutions): Works for me.
Rhea (legal): I'll be there.
Nora (partnerships): Meeting booked. I'll drop draft playbook + sample LOA to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/si-co-sell/handshake-playbook before EOD. :rocket:
